Product Description
Description

You've owned hoodies your whole life. Nothing like this one. The Signature Hoodie is what happens when you obsess over every detail—the weight, the fabric, the hood until it's not just a hoodie anymore. Crafted in our CloudTouch™ Heavyweight Fleece, with the iconic logo stitching. Over 20 million sold and counting.

Embroidered logo: a subtle signature detail on one of our most iconic hoodies
CloudTouch™ Heavyweight Fleece: the fabric that started the Comfrt movement
Oversized double-lined hood: the hood that feels like it was made for you
Kangaroo pocket: the classic finishing touch
Oversized fit: our classic silhouette built for all-day comfort

Perfect for:

Anyone who's been looking for their forever hoodie
Anxiety, stress, and everything in between
Days when you need to feel held together
Size & Fit
Oversized: Designed with extra room around the chest and shoulders with a taper down the body through the waist.
Fabric & Care
51% Cotton, 49% Polyester
Machine wash cold
Wash with like colors
Tumble dry low
Do not iron
Shipping Policy
We aim to process orders placed before 11AM PT (Mon–Fri) same day.
Orders placed after 11AM PT, or on weekends or holidays will process the next business day.
Please allow additional time during holidays or peak periods.
